verdict.rationale: The invoices API documents a flag to email payment reminders automatically when an invoice goes unpaid, and the marketing site claims "automated invoices and reminders." Recurring invoicing on a schedule is only implied by "automated invoices" and is never explicitly documented. missing for 10: explicit documentation of recurring invoice schedules (frequency, start/end), reminder timing/cadence configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can set up recurring invoices and automatic payment reminders for overdue customers

citations.quote: `true` to email payment reminders if the invoice goes unpaid, `false` otherwise
Save time by creating customised, automated invoices and reminders.
